verdict.rationale: Wave is a small-business accounting SaaS, so official SDKs are a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents an official SDK. The only developer-related item notes a GraphQL API portal that could not be crawled, and says the public pages document no API, MCP, CLI, or webhook surface. An API by itself is not an official SDK, so there is no direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
